title: Claim
description: One Claim (CONTEXT.md; PLAN 5 and M20; ADR 0011, ADR 0034): the front matter of content/claims/{id}.md. The text under the front matter is the quote, verbatim. A Claim is a record and the Readings needed to examine it. There is no field for a finding, a rating, a label or a context flag, here or in a Claim lock, and unknown fields are refused: a judgment on a Claim is a user's own and lives in that user's notes.

id.description: Permanent: said_on, then a slug. The file is named for it.

said_on.description: The New York calendar day the statement was made.

said_at.description: The instant it was made, in UTC, when known. It falls on said_on in New York. With it the Cutoff is that instant; without it, 00:00 New York on said_on (D7).

sources.description: Two or more records of the statement, each archived (ADR 0011).

readings_not_measured.description: Other ways the words could be read that this record does not measure, each in a line.

checked_on.description: The New York calendar day the Claim was recorded and its figures computed (now when checked).

status.description: A draft is never in a public-profile Release. Only a person makes a Claim public (D7).

id.description: Names the Reading within its Claim. Permanent once locked.

freq.description: A slower frequency to bring the Series to before anything else. Absent: the Series' own.

transform.description: One of the engine's Transforms (docs/method/transforms.md). rebase, z and drawdown depend on a window and go only with a measure that has one.

measure.description: The closed list (PLAN 4.5). Each returns numbers, never true or false.

period.description: value_at, rank: the Period measured, as a label at the Reading's frequency.

periods.description: difference: two Periods; the answer is the second less the first.

which.description: extreme: the largest or the smallest value.

order.description: rank: whether 1 is the highest value or the lowest.

alternative_windows.description: Other windows the same measure is taken over, so a reader sees how much the declared one matters (Window sensitivity). Only with change, extreme or rank.

claimReading.title: ClaimReading
claimReading.description: One way to turn a Claim's words into something measurable (CONTEXT.md, Reading). Which fields go with which measure is in docs/method/claims.md; both atlas check and the engine hold a Reading to it. There is no field for what the figures show.

archive_url.description: An archived copy of the address. A Claim's source has no exception.

locator.description: Where in the source the words are: a time in a recording, a page, a paragraph.

kind.description: What kind of record it is. Two sources of one Claim are different records of the statement.

role.description: The office or position held when the Claim was made.

party.description: The party at the time; "none" for a person with no party.

claimCorrection.title: ClaimCorrection
claimCorrection.description: A dated, public change to the Claim after publication, with the reason (CONTEXT.md, Correction).
